my-1999.notes: Sepang 2009 and 2012 rain-hit races establish tropical-storm potential, not a statistical race frequency. Conservative fitted tuning.

tr-2005.notes: The 2021 race remained suitable for intermediates throughout. Long damp persistence is intentional; numeric probability is fitted, not measured.

de-1932.notes: Hockenheim 2019 was rain-affected. One exceptional event is not treated as an annual probability; fitted conservative tuning.

ru-2014.notes: Sochi 2021 had a late rain front after a long dry phase. Probability is fitted, not an observed frequency.

pt-2008.notes: Portimao 2020 had light early rain but remained a slick-tyre race. Brief drizzle is not forced into a tyre-changing weather front.

fr-1969.notes: Paul Ricard 2022 was hot and tyre-limited. Fitted low change chance, not a multi-year measured rain frequency.

it-1914.notes: Mugello has only one F1 race, 2020. A single dry event cannot establish climatological frequency; conservative fitted tuning.

pt-1972.notes: Estoril 1985 stayed wet throughout. Long wet persistence is fitted from this example; probability is not a historical frequency estimate.

es-2026.notes: No comparable multi-season F1 weather series for this layout in the 2023–2025 window. Conservative dry tuning; not measured frequency.

in-vit-vellore.notes: Custom campus circuit with no F1 race-weather history. Conservative game tuning, not a verified local weather model.
